import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

export function makeTraceWriter(opts = {}) {
  const home = opts.home || process.env.DSH_HOME
  const dir = path.join(home, 'storages', 'cot-form-b')
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true })
  const p = path.join(dir, 'trace.log')
  return { path: p, write(tag, data) { fs.appendFileSync(p, `[${tag}] ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n`) } }
}
